tags.name: Marketing Carriers API
tags.description: The Marketing Carriers section provides access to information about transport providers. It allows users to retrieve a list of marketing carriers, view detailed carrier information including policies and fare classes, find stations served by a carrier, and get booking schemas for each carrier.

tags.name: Connections API
tags.description: The Connections section of the Distribusion API provides access to information about available transport connections, including details such as departure and arrival times, durations, and available services. This section allows users to search for connections based on various criteria, helping them plan their journeys effectively.

tags.name: Bookings API
tags.description: The Bookings section of the Distribusion API enables users to create and manage bookings for transport services. It provides functionality to create new bookings, retrieve booking details, and manage existing bookings, facilitating a seamless booking experience through the platform.

tags.name: Reservations API
tags.description: The Reservations section of the Distribusion API allows users to create reservations, cancel reservations, confirm reservations and retrieve detailed information about existing reservations made through the platform.

tags.name: Payment Items API
tags.description: The Payment Items section of the Distribusion API provides functionality to manage payment items associated with reservations.

tags.name: Cancellations API
tags.description: The Cancellations section allows users to cancel bookings and retrieve cancellation conditions. It provides functionality to check cancellation fees and refund amounts before proceeding, and supports both full and partial cancellations (by connection or passenger).

tags.name: Stations API
tags.description: The Stations section of the Distribusion API provides access to information about transport stations.

tags.name: Cards API
tags.description: The Cards section of the Distribusion API provides access to information about available cards for booking.

value.description:
Identifier or coordinates of the location, depending on `type`:
- `stations` - **array** of strings exactly 8 uppercase letters long (`^[A-Z]{8}$`)
- `city` - string exactly 5 uppercase letters long (`^[A-Z]{5}$`)
- `area` - string exactly 7 uppercase letters long (`^[A-Z]{7}$`)
- `iata` - string exactly 3 uppercase letters long (`^[A-Z]{3}$`)
- `uic` - string containing only digits (`^\d+$`)
- `geo` - string in format `latitude,longitude` with exactly 6 decimal places each (`^(-?\d+\.\d{6}),(-?\d+\.\d{6})$`)
